item.title: Self-Hosted Redis Search & Analytics: RediSearch vs RedisInsight vs RedisTimeSeries
item.description: Redis is widely known as an in-memory cache and data structure store, but its module ecosystem extends far beyond simple key-value operations. Three Redis modules — RediSearch, RedisInsight, and RedisTimeSeries — transform Redis into a full-featured search engine, analytics dashboard, and time-series database. This guide explores how to self-host and leverage these powerful Redis extensions for search, observability, and time-series workloads.
